degree.text: Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering.

description.text: Teaching Objectives After graduation you will be equipped the knowledge of advanced technology and engineering . You can also be engaged in petroleum engineering design, operation and construction, production and management, scientific development and applied research Main courses Oil and Gas Well Engineering, Oil and Gas Development Engineering; Advanced Math, Physics, Program Design Language, Chemistry, Oil Field Chemistry, Fluid Mechanics, Theory Mechanics, Material Mechanics, Oil Field Development Geology, Well-drilling Engineering, Oil Production Engineering, Reservoir Engineering etc. Internship Practice, course design, surveying and mapping practice, graduation practice, graduation design. Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Engineering. Future Career 1.Specialize in environmental safety regulations. 2.Move into other areas such as entrepreneurship and consulting. 3.Sales engineering which involves the service and testing functions for various types of equipment in the industry.

duration.text: The Petroleum and Gas Storage and Transportation Engineering at LiaoNing Petrochemical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 2. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated intoChinese or English and be notarized. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper. 5. Sponsorship Certificate

requirements.text: 1.Must be a high school graduate 2.In good health 3.Have a good command of English
